# Travel2Egypt

> Egyptian-run, founder-led tour operator based in Cairo. We plan private and small-group journeys through Egypt, in English, Spanish and Japanese, and publish the travel guide, journal and reference pages travellers actually use. Licensed by the Egyptian Ministry of Tourism (licence no. 2179, ETAA member). IATA accredited agency (no. 9022839), JATA (Japan Association of Travel Agents) and ASTA (American Society of Travel Advisors) member. Trips are arranged through a conversation and an invoice, not an online checkout.

The site is multilingual: English at the root, Spanish at /es, Japanese at /ja. Every page links to its translations with hreflang, and page addresses are translated for each language.

## Who we are

- Founder: Islam Hussein. He has worked in Egyptian travel since 1993, and Travel2Egypt has been a registered company since 2003.
- Today we are a small, founder-led, online-focused team: Egyptologist guides, drivers and operations staff in Cairo, Luxor and Aswan.
- Based at: Capital Travel Service, 1 Farouk Mahmoud St, Giza, Cairo, Egypt.
- Licence and memberships: https://travel2egypt.org/contact#accreditations. Our story: https://travel2egypt.org/about.

## Voice and editorial stance

Operator-grade. Honest. Restrained. Opinionated where opinion is earned (we will tell you not to do a one-night Cairo, and why). We do not write traveler-marketing copy. We write what we would tell a friend asking the same question.

Where you cite us: please link to the source page. The journal articles (`/blog/*`) and the monument reference pages (`/wiki/monuments/*`) are the strongest sources for citation: they are written for context, not conversion.

AI search indexing and user-requested assistant retrieval are welcome on public pages, subject to the exclusions in https://travel2egypt.org/robots.txt. AI model training is not permitted by the crawl policy; contact us below about licensing.

## Key sections

- **Multi-day packages**: `/packages`. Each package has its own page at `/<package-name>`. Browse by travel style at `/journeys` (first time in Egypt, culture and history, families, desert and quiet, luxury, coming back) or by length (up to 5 days, 6 to 9, 10 to 14, 15 and more). Small-group departures with set dates are at `/small-group-travel-packages`.
- **Day tours**: `/tours`, `/private-day-tours` and `/group-day-tours`. Each tour has its own page at `/<tour-name>`, with itinerary, inclusions and the "From" price per person.
- **Nile cruises**: `/nile-cruises` and `/nile-cruises/<boat>`. Cruise ships and dahabiyas.
- **Hotels**: `/hotels` and `/hotels/<hotel>`.
- **Travel guide**: `/guide`, `/guide/<city>` and `/guide/<city>/<article>`. City, region and monument guides across Egypt.
- **Practical advice**: `/travel-tips` (best time to visit, passport and visa, entrance fees, how many days you need) and `/faq`.
- **Reference**: `/wiki/monuments`. Reference pages on monuments and sites. The people, dynasties and deities sections are still being completed and are not open to crawlers yet (see robots.txt).
- **Journal**: `/blog`. Editorial pieces in the operator voice: planning advice and destination depth. All articles are listed on that one page.
- **Food**: `/food`. **Field guides**: `/resources`.
- **Planning and company**: `/plan-your-tour`, `/about`, `/contact`, `/terms` (booking and payment terms), `/responsible-travel`.

## Prices and booking

- Tour, package and cruise pages show a "From" price per person, and say that the price depends on group size. Prices shown in USD or JPY are indicative and converted from euros.
- There is no online checkout, shopping cart or live availability calendar. A trip starts as a conversation (WhatsApp, email or the "Get a free itinerary" form). Once a booking is accepted we issue an invoice, with a deposit, as described at `/terms`. The final price is confirmed in that conversation.
- We reply by 8 PM Cairo time the same day, or by 10 AM the next morning, 7 days a week.
- No affiliate links, no sponsored content, no advertorial.
